# Supplier evidence

`startek_sales_policy.jpg` is a marketing image downloaded from https://entft.tft-tft.com/2025111311183643.jpg, linked by Startek's website. It describes general sales policy; it is not a mechanical drawing or evidence of stock for the selected suffix. Copyright remains with its owner.

Selected display listing: [KD024QVFMA020-C003A](https://www.startek-lcd.com/product/474-KD024QVFMA020-C003A-2.4-inch-240x320-ST7789V-IPS-LCD-module-with-build-in-capacitive-touch-panel.html).

The listing's drawing URL, https://www.startek-lcd.com/upload/202001/10/202001101653212CA1.jpg, returned 404 during this work. Obtain a controlled drawing and a physical sample before manufacturing approval. Display solids and flex/connector allocations in this repository use nominal listing dimensions, not downloaded manufacturer CAD.

The DAC and XIAO manufacturer STEP dependencies remain under `revision_04/vendor/`; see that directory's README for provenance.
